summary: Onar Holding's subsidiary ONAR, LLC filed an 8-K disclosing its September 29, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement to acquire all membership interests of Advertise Purple LLC from Advertise Purple Holdings Inc. Consideration totals $12.825 million cash (including $1.25 million previously paid deposits), a $7.0 million unsecured Seller Note, and up to $8.0 million in cash earnouts tied to gross profit across three annual periods ending September 2028-2029. The target became an indirect wholly owned subsidiary; no board recommendation, advisor, or financing collateral details were disclosed.
